title: Plan
body: Challenge is Skill authoring (structured paper notes). Reuse pdf-evidence-reader v0.3 parser; add outline repair, digest with block anchors, draft template and a verifier that checks every note against the PDF.

tool_output: 16 sections; appendices A-C nested under References (bug to repair)

tool_args.cmd: notes.py init/build on ResNet with mixed good/bad draft

tool_output: wrong number and fabricated quote failed; paraphrase fuzzy; wrong block relocated; fixed 'top-5' number parsing, alias dedupe, abbreviation expansion, row-level table quotes

tool_args.cmd: init on zh sample, scanned, encrypted, 1502.03167, 2203.15556, gpt3, glove

tool_output: BN paper: junk '1 N' headings, sections 2-3.4 missed; GloVe 4.4 missed; scanned: 0 sections -> added heading repair, image-only pseudo sections
